case_number: 2024 INSC 324; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Special Leave to Petition (Crl.) No.2520 OF 2017)
summary: Second FIR quashed due to abuse of process; identical allegations in prior FIR at Hisar; Udaipur complaint not prior; Rajasthan Police aware of prior proceedings; quashing justified despite acquittal in first case; misuse of state machinery condemned; costs imposed on complainant for harassment.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.498A, s.406, s.384, s.420, s.120(B), s.506
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.300, s.177, s.461
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order quashed; FIR No. 156 of 2015 quashed; costs of Rs. 5,00,000/- imposed on respondent No.2.
